# DMC Global to Report Third Quarter Financial Results on October 27, 2026


October 14, 2026 7:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c9a9f6b95d6ae34f2c0372bbba5cde10/dmcglobal/news/2026-10-14_DMC_Global_to_Report_Third_Quarter_Financial_191.pdf)


BROOMFIELD, Colo., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- DMC Global Inc. (Nasdaq: BOOM) will report financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the stock market closes on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. Management will host a conference call and simultaneous webcast to discuss the results.


The conference call will begin at 5 p.m. Eastern (3 p.m. Mountain) and will be accessible by dialing 877-407-5783 (or +1-201-689-8782 for international callers).

**About DMC Global**
DMC Global is an owner and operator of innovative, asset-light manufacturing businesses that provide unique, highly engineered products and differentiated solutions. DMC’s businesses have established leadership positions in their respective markets and consist of: Arcadia, a leading supplier of architectural building products; DynaEnergetics, which serves the global energy industry; and NobelClad, which addresses the global industrial infrastructure and transportation sectors. Based in Broomfield, Colorado, DMC trades on Nasdaq under the symbol “BOOM.” For more information, visit:[http://www.dm](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=2I5UU_1LPvm-Tyfba-jeQZkfOTBFfGcSMkQoCKtSSoD7HN5X_a0OHjSjyEU9_aCH11q-EVd9bflwRY4RdiEaVQ==) c[global.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=lCELPENwmOLQCF9u4w6ORtLVEr23_wfLZQkhj8fz6wQvBPDfhssSRogTgAEZ8VfDPsk54qx6V1E_5tj8JPBivA==) .
